name: Forest fires in Australia
summary: Between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-18, HH backscatter here changed by -0.1 dB and HV by +0.2 dB (mean within 500 m). Across the mapped area, 0% got at least 3 dB weaker and 0% at least 3 dB stronger.
